Kamien Pomorski Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Kamień Pomorski, Poland

Demolished. Kamień Pomorski's Jewish cemetery, established at the beginning of the 19th century, survived unharmed through the Nazi period, with its last burial taking place in 1931. It was formally closed by Communist provincial authorities in 1961, and in 1968 — during the state-sponsored antisemitic campaign that swept Poland that year — the Minister of the Interior personally ordered its full liquidation, with human remains and tombstones removed entirely. A 1996 memorial plaque, erected at the initiative of a local historical club, was destroyed within days of its installation; a more permanent obelisk finally followed in 2008.
